note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS wording and the translator-rendered Old Testament verses the first edition carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, whole OWB sentences, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'; verbatim recitations without quote marks count. Where the quoted words stand in another verse, the citation names that verse (Isa 53:4-5, Mark 8:35, Gen 18:14, Luke 18:41 for Bartimaeus, Mark 13:22-23). Where Simpson's next sentence dwells on a quoted word, that echo follows OWB's word (Matt 8:17 ወሰደ, 1 Pet 2:24 ሰንበር, 2 Cor 5:5 ቀብድ, Mark 9:24's cry without 'Lord'), and the refrain 'Thy will be done' is OWB's «ፈቃድህ ይሁን». Isa 53:4's AV 'Surely', which Simpson argues from, is carried by a one-time gloss in his prose.

`self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are allusions and Simpson's own literal or re-personed renderings woven into his sentences, Eph 5:30's 'of his flesh, and of his bones' (absent from OWB's critical text; OWB's words plus the clause rendered from the English), and the verses where he argues from an AV wording OWB does not carry: Mark 11:22 'the faith of God', Luke 4:39 'rebuked the fever', Mark 8:25 'made him look up', Acts 14:10's two-part command and Exod 15:25 'a statute and an ordinance'.
